final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS average_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS average_kept_count, AVG(g.invoice_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts AS g JOIN overall AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.invoice_count > a.average_count
